meta.title: Iceberg Kafka Connect #16282: one data file registered in two snapshots

views.label: Healthy commit cycle
views.note: The coordinator opens commit A, the worker writes file X and reports it on the control topic.

views.label: Rebalance rewinds the reader
views.note: An eager reassignment drops the fetch position, so already buffered events are replayed.

views.label: Snapshot with a stale floor
views.note: Snapshot S1 holds files through offset 7 but records a control-topic floor of 2.

views.label: Second registration
views.note: Offsets 2-7 pass the stale floor, so file X is appended a second time.

messages.label: StartCommit(commit id A)
messages.note: Coordinator.process opens a cycle when the commit interval is reached; the control topic fans StartCommit out to every sink task.

messages.label: DataWritten(file X) + DataComplete, offsets 0-7
messages.note: File X already exists in object storage at this point.

messages.label: poll: buffer envelopes 0-7, offsets map = {0: 8}
messages.note: Channel.consumeAvailable stores record.offset() + 1 with a plain put().

messages.label: eager re-assignment replays from offset 0, map regresses to {0: 2}
messages.note: The default RangeAssignor protocol is eager, so a reassignment discards the fetch position with no explicit seek. The buffer still holds envelopes through offset 7, and the replayed DataComplete makes the commit fire early.

messages.label: newAppend: file X, summary offsets {0: 2}
messages.note: The coordinator reads the previous floor from the snapshot ancestry first; there is none yet, and the summary floor it writes comes from the regressed map rather than from the envelopes being committed.

messages.label: swap pointer: S1 holds offsets 0-7, advertises floor 2
next cycle re-delivers offsets 2-7, all above the stale floor
messages.note: The envelope filter only drops offsets strictly below the recorded floor.

messages.label: newAppend: file X again, no file location check
messages.note: distinctByKey removes duplicates inside one batch only; AppendFiles never compares against files already in the table.

messages.label: second successful swap: Snapshot S2 registers file X
S2 reaches file X twice, every row is read twice

cards.title: Why the recorded floor regresses
items: The offsets map uses put(), so a replay lowers it
Eager assignment drops the fetch position silently
The buffer keeps the higher offsets already consumed

cards.title: Why nothing rejects the second append
items: AppendFiles never checks for an already registered file
distinctByKey only dedupes inside one commit batch
The validator sees the regressed floor on both sides

cards.title: Where a fix would land
items: Reset in-flight commit state on control-topic revoke
Seek forward on assignment keeps the floor monotonic
Deterministic de-election removes the zombie coordinator
